kind: standalone photographic 2.5D tutorial motion study; not production integration

assets.purpose: Remove foreground guide and reconstruct occluded counter/gate; preserve receptionist
Reframe far-right cinema entrance as high-resolution near view
Extract foreground director into transparent canvas with matching pose and placement

limitations: Guide is a static RGBA image; no walking or lip animation.
Generated clean/near plates and cutout are derivatives; not exact recovered camera geometry or original segmentation pixels.
Desk/lounge/cinema views are joined with short dissolves, not one physically continuous camera traversal.
Optional speech uses an installed browser Korean voice, not an approved character performance.
Under sustained slow frames only the moving canvas reduces rendering scale to .65; still/paused and actual HTML interface remain full resolution.
Actual menu iframe reads whichever local app build exists; it is not a second implemented cinema UI.
